name: MGA Welfare Assistance Program grants
summary: One-off grants that don't need to be repaid, for Monash graduate students in financial hardship, covering food, study, medical and emergency costs.
key: Hardship grants of up to $500 per semester, with other grants from $50 food vouchers to $500.
who: Graduate students currently enrolled through a Monash Australian campus.
Experiencing financial hardship and meeting the criteria for the specific grant.
how: Log in with your student email address and submit the online application form.
Attach proof of enrolment and evidence of hardship such as 30-day bank statements.
catches: Doesn't cover tuition, debt repayment, leisure travel, immigration costs or costs more than 30 days old.
Hardship grant isn't open to international students in their first six months.
Paid by EFT into an Australian bank account only.

source.label: Monash Graduate Association: Welfare Assistance Program

evidence.quote: Unlike a loan, a grant does not need to be repaid.
